summary: Anthropic launched a beta 'reflect' dashboard feature in Claude that lets users review their usage patterns, get suggestions on how to work with Claude more effectively, and set usage reminders like quiet hours.

practices.reason: A new settings-level feature is available for web and desktop Claude clients that engineering teams integrating Claude might want to be aware of, though it creates no required work.
practices.quote: This tool is currently available in beta for Free, Pro, and Max users who have memory turned on.
